edits.old: A service-identity author may be approved by a person; the same person may not author and approve.
edits.new: A service-identity author may be approved by a person; a service identity may not approve; the same person may not author and approve. Both the author reference and the approver reference are recorded in the decision-record entry.

edits.old: takes effect on a date, not on the day it was approved.
edits.new: takes effect on a date, not on the day it was approved. A version takes effect from its valid-from date only and never retroactively. An approval given before that date is allowed: the version reads APPROVED until the date and IN_FORCE from it, and the version it supersedes keeps valid-to set to the day before.

edits.old: this story fixes the two operations the route calls.
edits.new: this story fixes the two console operations the route calls, the approve and the return under /api/recovery/access/v1/admin/lov-loads. The version transition stays with rwb-case and is called as a consumed contract; the approve path is reconciled with the ownership map at contract review before either is frozen. No masking-profile operation and no PII table belong to this story: the unmask read goes through the ACE Common PII logging client, and a rule's view and column resolve through the field id of the P1 field registry.
